module: Auxiliary controller for trailer kickstands: writes an electric ("feet" by default) to an "attached" value when a coupler of this vehicle attaches to ANOTHER vehicle and to a "detached" value when it detaches. The electric is used to animate/retract the kickstands.
notes: jbeam keys read: electricsName ("feet"), attachedValue (1), detachedValue (0), startValue (0, initial value).
Couplers attached to the same vehicle (obj2id == obj:getId()) are ignored.
Pitfall: the expression `jbeamData.attachedValue or 1` gives 1 if the jbeam value is false, but 0 is a valid value in Lua so it is OK; only watch out for nil values.

init.desc: Reads the configuration and initializes the electric to startValue.

onCouplerAttached.desc: Hook called by the engine when a coupler attaches; if the other object is another vehicle, sets the electric to attachedValue.

onCouplerDetached.desc: Hook called when a coupler detaches; if the other object is another vehicle, sets the electric to detachedValue.
